style: Night set in Maya's room (moon and stars in the window, warm desk-lamp glow, spark poster pale behind her). Maya waist up behind the desk with her pencil bun; Floey perched on the laptop lid facing her (facing -1, side view). One red DUO.stat pill near Maya's head through the hook, and one cutaway: the host bot log listInsert, tagged as Maya's example. No notification. Flowra appears only in the end card.

panels.subject: wide: Maya behind the desk, pose type, face worried, eyes down at the laptop; Floey perched on the laptop lid; red DUO.stat pill by Maya's head (x 880, y 610, bad tone)
panels.action: Opens mid-panic: Maya is already hammering the keys on 'I've allowed GPTBot in my robots.txt', and a '!' mark pops above her bun. Floey tilts her head slowly toward her.

panels.subject: wide nudged in slightly (both still fully in frame, pill inside the safe area): Maya and Floey
panels.action: On 'Still bounced!' Maya slams the save key, switches to pose panic with hands by her head and face panic. Floey answers with one slow, unimpressed blink.

panels.subject: floeyTight: Floey alone on the laptop lid, mood think, deadpan
panels.action: Floey gives a small head bob on 'note on the door', then a slow blink and a tilt on 'Not the bouncer.' Her feathers settle afterwards.

panels.subject: maya: Maya alone, the red pill still by her head
panels.action: Reaction cut on 'bouncer': Maya's hands freeze above the keys (pose rest), face surprised, a small jolt.

panels.subject: maya: Maya alone, the red pill still by her head
panels.action: She looks up and to the left toward Floey (look -1, -0.3), pose chin, face think with brows raised, and asks 'Then who's the bouncer?' A slow push on the question.

panels.subject: floey: closer two-shot favouring Floey on the laptop, Maya at the frame edge, fully in frame
panels.action: On 'Your host.' Floey turns her head toward the laptop screen, then back to Maya with one blink for 'Check its bot settings, not just the file.' Maya nods once and drops into pose type, face think, eyes down at the laptop.

panels.subject: Laptop screen insert (DUO.listInsert), screen space: title 'My host's bot log (today)', sub 'Maya's example', cols Bot / Response. The only cutaway in the reel.
panels.action: The insert swings in. Rows slide in one by one: GPTBot / 429 Too many requests (bad tone, hi row), OAI-SearchBot / 200 OK, ClaudeBot / 200 OK, Googlebot / 200 OK.

panels.subject: The same bot log insert, held, with a slight push toward the GPTBot row
panels.action: Under Maya's 'Wait. Too many requests?' the hiK ring grows around the GPTBot 429 row while every other row reads 200 OK.

panels.subject: mayaTight: Maya's face fills the frame
panels.action: The insert cuts out. On 'Everyone else got in.' Maya jabs pose point at the laptop, and her face goes from surprised to annoyed with her eyes narrowing.

panels.subject: wide: Maya behind the desk, Floey lifting off the laptop to floeyHover at Maya's eye height on her left
panels.action: Floey lifts off with a wing flutter and hovers by Maya's head on 'Your note said come in.' Maya stares at the laptop, face annoyed, mouth flat, pose crossed. The red pill starts fading because she now knows the reason.

panels.subject: floey: two-shot favouring Floey hovering by Maya's head, Maya fully in frame
panels.action: On 'slow down' Floey tilts toward Maya. Maya slowly turns her eyes to Floey, face deadpan. The pill is gone.

panels.subject: maya: Maya alone (Floey out of frame flies back to the laptop lid during this shot)
panels.action: Talking to herself, 'Right. Saving this for my next audit.', Maya switches to pose phone and raises her phone to the laptop to screenshot the bot log, face think and then a small proud nod.

panels.subject: floeyTight: Floey back on the laptop lid
panels.action: Floey pivots to face the camera, mood happy and smug, with a tiny preen of one wing on 'You're welcome.'

panels.subject: mayaTight: Maya, phone still raised in hand
panels.action: The button: Maya slowly turns to the camera, face annoyed going deadpan, and gives one long flat look with no words. A very slow push holds about 1.3 seconds of silent acting.

panels.subject: End card: the Flowra logo intact, 'Maya & Floey, every day', Floey perched on the spark's left arm facing the camera
panels.action: The end card lands and Floey settles on the spark's arm.
